lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Correction and reflection: reflecting without shame

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice reflecting without shame. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner looks back across the entire capstone — choosing, planning, safety review, doing, and checking — and identifies one specific thing that didn't go as planned, then practices describing it factually, as information for next time, rather than as a personal failure.
safetyNotes: No shame or self-critical language is used by the adult or the learner anywhere in this lesson.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: If you did a second capstone contribution, what's the one specific thing from this reflection you'd carry forward into planning it?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Shame-to-fact reframing: Final summary is entirely in fact language. | Forward-looking specificity: Forward plan names one specific thing to carry forward. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Help a family member reframe one of their own 'that didn't go as planned' moments from shame language into fact language, using the same method.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice reflecting without shame. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: reflecting without shame worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner looks back across the entire capstone — choosing, planning, safety review, doing, and checking — and identifies one specific thing that didn't go as planned, then practices describing it factually, as information for next time, rather than as a personal failure.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact reflecting without shame decision or action.
Model move 2: Before reflecting, notice: does your first instinct describe what didn't go as planned using shame language ('I'm bad at this') or fact language ('this step took longer than planned')?
Model move 3: With your adult, take your warm-up sentence and rewrite it in fact language if it used shame language, then talk through why the fact version is more useful.
Model check: Shame-to-fact reframing: Final summary is entirely in fact language. | Forward-looking specificity: Forward plan names one specific thing to carry forward.

resources.title: reflecting without shame action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for reflecting without shame.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: reflecting without shame coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner looks back across the entire capstone — choosing, planning, safety review, doing, and checking — and identifies one specific thing that didn't go as planned, then practices describing it factually, as information for next time, rather than as a personal failure.

Coach direction: Before reflecting, notice: does your first instinct describe what didn't go as planned using shame language ('I'm bad at this') or fact language ('this step took longer than planned')?
Learner prompt: Write your first-instinct sentence.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: reflecting without shame complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: With your adult, take your warm-up sentence and rewrite it in fact language if it used shame language, then talk through why the fact version is more useful.
Response 1 (t2-p1): My rewritten sentence describes what happened, not who I am.
Response 2 (t2-p2): My adult and I discussed why fact language helps more than shame language for next time.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I did not use words like 'lazy,' 'bad at this,' or 'stupid' in my final version.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: reflecting without shame minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: If you did a second capstone contribution, what's the one specific thing from this reflection you'd carry forward into planning it?
Success checks: Shame-to-fact reframing: Final summary is entirely in fact language. | Forward-looking specificity: Forward plan names one specific thing to carry forward.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: reflecting without shame supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional reflecting without shame condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Shame-to-fact reframing: Final summary is entirely in fact language. | Forward-looking specificity: Forward plan names one specific thing to carry forward..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: The learner looks back across the entire capstone — choosing, planning, safety review, doing, and checking — and identifies one specific thing that didn't go as planned, then practices describing it factually, as information for next time, rather than as a personal failure.
coachMoves: Ask the learner to name the condition.
Point to one model step only.
Give feedback against one observable success check.

simulationRoute.title: reflecting without shame — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the reflecting without shame task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Shame-to-fact reframing: Final summary is entirely in fact language. | Forward-looking specificity: Forward plan names one specific thing to carry forward.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
